HomePage.faq1q: When does the FIFA World Cup 2026 start?
HomePage.faq1a: FIFA World Cup 2026 begins in June 2026, with matches across the United States, Mexico, and Canada. Kickoff times and full schedules are confirmed closer to the tournament.
HomePage.faq2q: How do I read World Cup moneyline (1X2) odds?
HomePage.faq2a: The three-way market lists prices for a home win, draw, or away win. Lower decimal odds imply a higher implied probability; comparing books helps you find the best return on the same outcome.
HomePage.faq3q: Are World Cup odds the same at every sportsbook?
HomePage.faq3a: No — books set their own prices and margins. Small differences add up, which is why comparing world cup 2026 odds before you bet matters.
